preconditions.description: T is an integer between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(N == int(N) and 3 <= N <= 1000 for N in [int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit() and int(line) >= 3 and int(line) <= 1000])
preconditions.description: Each N is an integer between 3 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(S) == len(P) == N for N, S, P in [(int(stdin.readline()), stdin.readline().strip(), stdin.readline().strip())])
preconditions.description: For each test case, S and P have the same length N.

preconditions.expression: all(S in {'0', '1'}**N and P in {'0', '1'}**N for N, S, P in [(int(stdin.readline()), stdin.readline().strip(), stdin.readline().strip())])
preconditions.description: S and P are binary strings of length N.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout.strip() in {'YES', 'NO'} for stdout in [line.strip() for line in stdout.splitlines()])
postconditions.description: Each output line is either 'YES' or 'NO' (case insensitive).

postconditions.expression: all((S == P) == (stdout.strip() == 'YES') for N, S, P, stdout in zip([int(stdin.readline()) for _ in range(T)], [stdin.readline().strip() for _ in range(T)], [stdin.readline().strip() for _ in range(T)], [line.strip() for line in stdout.splitlines()]))
postconditions.description: For each test case, output 'YES' if and only if S can be transformed into P using the allowed operations.

postconditions.expression: all((sum(S) == sum(P)) or (sum(S) == N and sum(P) == 0) or (sum(S) == 0 and sum(P) == N) for N, S, P in [(int(stdin.readline()), stdin.readline().strip(), stdin.readline().strip())])
postconditions.description: If S can be transformed into P, then either the number of 1s in S and P are equal, or one is all 0s and the other is all 1s.
